task_title: Close error_class gaps: upstream, auth, unobserved tool calls
task_criteria: PROOF: go test ./pkg/mcp/ -count=1 -run "TestMCPErrorClass_HandlerDeclaredClasses|TestServerToolObserver_UpstreamAndAuthClassesRecorded|TestServerToolObserver_UnknownToolRecordedAsError|TestObserveToolCall_LabelSetIsClosedEnum|TestServerToolObserver_BadParamsRecordedAsError" passes at the integrated tip, and pkg/mcp/tool_observer.go mcpErrorClass maps a handler-declared upstream_error marker to the upstream metric class and credential_rejected/missing_credential markers to the auth metric class instead of internal. FAILIF: any named test fails, a tools/call whose structured result carries the upstream_error marker records muster_mcp_tool_executions_total with error_class=internal, or any emitted error_class label falls outside the closed enum none/auth/upstream/validation/internal.

items.criterion: PROOF: go test ./pkg/mcp/ -count=1 -run "TestMCPErrorClass_HandlerDeclaredClasses|TestServerToolObserver_UpstreamAndAuthClassesRecorded|TestServerToolObserver_UnknownToolRecordedAsError|TestObserveToolCall_LabelSetIsClosedEnum|TestServerToolObserver_BadParamsRecordedAsError" passes at the integrated tip, and pkg/mcp/tool_observer.go mcpErrorClass maps a handler-declared upstream_error marker to the upstream metric class and credential_rejected/missing_credential markers to the auth metric class instead of internal. FAILIF: any named test fails, a tools/call whose structured result carries the upstream_error marker records muster_mcp_tool_executions_total with error_class=internal, or any emitted error_class label falls outside the closed enum none/auth/upstream/validation/internal.
items.detail: (a) Ran the exact named command fresh: exit_code 0, all five tests --- PASS, `ok github.com/wojons/muster/pkg/mcp 0.021s`; full package `go test ./pkg/mcp/ -count=1` also ok (1.982s) and go vet clean. (b) Mapping: pkg/mcp/tool_observer.go metricClass() returns errorClassUpstream for handlers.ErrorClassUpstream (constant "upstream_error", pkg/mcp/handlers/tool_errors.go:26) and errorClassAuth for handlers.ReasonCredentialRejected/ReasonMissingCredential (tool_errors.go:43,46) — neither falls to internal. End-to-end proof via real dispatch (pkg/mcp/server.go:283 handler.Handle → :284 observeToolCall): TestServerToolObserver_UpstreamAndAuthClassesRecorded asserts muster_mcp_tool_executions_total{tool=flaky,status=error,error_class=upstream}=1 and {tool=profile,error_class=auth}=1. (c) Closed enum: observer constants are exactly none/auth/upstream/validation/internal (tool_observer.go:43-50); TestObserveToolCall_LabelSetIsClosedEnum walks all gathered metric label pairs rejecting anything outside that set and cross-checks each spelling against the sink's NormalizeMCPErrorClass (internal/monitoring/muster.go:330-337, which accepts only auth/upstream/validation/internal and normalizes the rest to internal), plus asserts no raw error text (`secret-token-abc`, `upstream 500`) reaches any label. [resolution 0.47; pkg/mcp/tool_observer.go]

items.criterion: derived: Production reachability — the observer is installed at the cmd/mcp-server entrypoint so real tools/call traffic is observed
items.detail: cmd/mcp-server/main.go:307 `server.SetToolCallObserver(mcp.NewMCPToolObserver(metricsRecorder, auditHook, mcpActorID()))` runs before runMCPServer/server.Run on the same server that loadAndRegisterTools registers handlers.NewCallToolHandler(executor) on (main.go:401, 415-416). Server.handleRequest is the sole handler dispatch point (only `handler.Handle(ctx` call site: pkg/mcp/server.go:283), so every tools/call — OpenAPI, gRPC (grpc_integration.go), asyncapi, graphql, jsonrpc registries all feed NewCallToolHandler — passes through observeToolCall.

items.criterion: derived: Seam fidelity — the marker shape toolResultError parses is exactly the shape the CallTool handler renders
items.detail: pkg/mcp/handlers/types.go:313 renders StructuredContent{"error": toolErrorMeta(...)} with class/code keys; CallToolResult JSON tags are `isError`/`structuredContent` (types.go:94-95), matching toolResultError's envelope (tool_observer.go) key-for-key. The seam is proven end-to-end, not unit-only: TestServerToolObserver_UpstreamAndAuthClassesRecorded sends cannedExecutor errors through real handleRequest dispatch and observes the correct upstream/auth classes on the gathered counter.

items.criterion: derived: Protocol neutrality — observing a tool call does not change the JSON-RPC response bytes (the 'unobserved tool calls' gap must not be closed by altering responses)
items.detail: observeToolCall is called after handler.Handle and before identical sendError/sendResponse logic (pkg/mcp/server.go:283-292). TestServerToolObserver_UnknownToolRecordedAsError and TestServerToolObserver_LeavesProtocolResponseUnchanged byte-compare observed vs plain server output (`plainOut != observedOut` fails) and both pass in the named run; the unknown-tool test also confirms the isError:true result shape is preserved.
